entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Razor Tag Helpers with ParentTag appear to not execute at all despite supposedly matching. #85971
  • Inconsistent handling of side effects around multiplication by 0 for `ref` inputs. #85970
    .NET 12
  • Inconsistent handling of side effects around "unused" `this` access in structures #85965

Closed

  • [LSP] Do not recompute syntax diagnostics if syntax has not changed #75241
    18.3
  • [Known Build Error] Daemon_EachServerHasAnIsolatedTelemetrySession #85947
  • `ITypeSymbol.AllInterfaces` is always empty for type parameters, contradicting its documentation ("the effective interface set of a type parameter") #85937
    Backlog
  • 16-bit char literals not working when source file encoded in UTF-8 #85956
  • A using directive in every file makes declaration binding quadratic in the number of syntax trees #85922
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix symbol-completion publication races #85972
  • Also filter out methods hidden by non-browsable methods in completion #85968
    Community, VSCode
  • Handle ref field dereference failures without aborting expansion #85967
    Community
  • Make RunTests framework defaults OS-specific #85966
  • Unsafe evolution: use C# 15 in LangVersion tests #85964
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Introduce a Razor DLL for `dotnet format`, and share formatting code #85963
    Needs API Review, Area-Razor
  • Ensure unused field value access evaluates all observable side effects #85962
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Locals and Returns
  • Unsafe evolution: unify requires-unsafe terminology #85961
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85960

Merged

  • Fix daemon telemetry isolation test race #85969
    VSCode, Next
  • Clarify type-parameter interface documentation #85952
    Next
  • Correct diagnostic inter-file dependency metadata #85953
    Community, VSCode, Area-Razor, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: update public API analyzer #85010
    Area-Analyzers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution, Next
  • Avoid quadratic namespace declaration lookup #85923
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Update developing on windows docs #85939
    Area-Infrastructure, Documentation, Community, Next

Updated

  • Fix race between FBP loader and LSP both opening a document #85942
    VSCode
  • Fix compilation caching across filtered generator runs #85935
    Community
  • Migrate tests to xUnit v3 #85776
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Add predicate version of IOperation.Descendants and DescendantsAndSelf #85898
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs API Review
  • Onboard build failure analysis workflow #85046
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • Bound local test partitions and collect hang dumps across platforms #85849
  • Fix handling of ref returning function pointers #85949
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85945
